topic: Testing if famous and regular basketball players can score on the world's largest 30-foot basketball hoop.

hook.first_words: This is the biggest basketball hoop in the world, and at first you probably think nobody could miss on a 30-foot rim this huge, but somehow almost everyone who tries it for the first time ends up missing.
hook.first_frame: A wide outdoor shot of the world's largest basketball hoop by the water, with a man standing nearby holding a basketball.

script: This is the biggest basketball hoop in the world, and at first you probably think nobody could miss on a 30-foot rim this huge. But somehow, almost everyone who tries it for the first time ends up missing. Even Lethal Shooter, who's famous for being insanely accurate, couldn't make it on his first attempt. It actually took him three tries before he finally knocked one down on the world's largest hoop.
retention_tricks: promise in the first sentence about missing easy shots
visual payoff of watching famous shooter miss
what_makes_it_work: High-contrast visual of a comically oversized basketball hoop.
Relatable surprise when skilled players miss easy-looking shots.
Fast pacing with rapid cuts keeping viewer attention high.
